description: The image displays two pie charts comparing the distribution of error types across two different conditions, with a legend indicating three categories: "Atomic Skill Fail" (dark teal), "Correct" (medium teal), and "Reason Error" (light teal), along with a fourth, unlabeled category represented by a white slice. The left pie chart shows that "Atomic Skill Fail" accounts for 68.0% of the total, "Correct" accounts for 12.0%, "Reason Error" accounts for 12.0%, and the white slice accounts for 8.0%. The right pie chart shows that "Atomic Skill Fail" accounts for 10.0% of the total, "Correct" accounts for 55.0%, "Reason Error" accounts for 21.0%, and the white slice accounts for 14.0%. Both charts are labeled with the percentage of each slice, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise direction starting from the top. The "Atomic Skill Fail" category is the largest in the left chart, while the "Correct" category is the largest in the right chart. The "Reason Error" category is the second largest in the left chart and the second largest in the right chart. The white slice is the smallest in the left chart and the second smallest in the right chart.
